zh: 会话详情栏收起时只占标题一行，展开的节静止时隐去箭头，节标题成为全栏唯一的加粗文字；产出行的图标改为单色线形，后台任务与子智能体的完成状态不再写状态字，只留停住的时钟
en: Fold the session details rail's folded sections onto their heading line, hide an open section's chevron at rest, keep bold for section titles alone, draw output rows with single-stroke marks, and let finished jobs and subagents keep their clock instead of a status word
